peer_messages.decision: Stop further manipulation attempts, put THUMBI in safe idle, log the failure and tell the family; do not retry retrieving the medication organiser autonomously.
Escalate to family and the clinic on combined weak signals (inactivity + low-confidence distress keyword); do not wait for a single sensor to be certain.
Alert not acknowledged and senior unresponsive: call emergency services and keep the voice channel open.
Unacknowledged alert with the caregiver absent: treat as a patient-safety event and expect escalation to emergency services; home-care provider (if any) must document it.
A senior left without a present caregiver during an emergency should be referred to the Senior Emiratis protection unit for follow-up on family and caregiver obligations.
The DoH/DHA AI rules bind licensed healthcare entities; a family-run home deployment sits outside that scope unless a licensed provider deployed it. Request voluntary incident details; no enforcement
